verdicts.note: 0 treats the record as balanced, but most of it points toward pole_b: she says Americans 'should not be subsidizing' the Netanyahu government's conduct and that the relationship 'must change' [S7], and voted no on the FY2027 NDAA [S10] and on H.R. 4795, the anti-boycott bill [S11]. The one pole_a item, her no vote on the Massie amendment, came with her stated reason that it also cut humanitarian and diplomatic aid [S7][S9]. The original basis also said she 'affirms Israel's right to defend itself', which no dossier source records; that clause was removed from the basis.

+2 (fully 'reduce & recondition') overstates the evidence. The Pentagon-audit and contractor-spending planks [S4] are pole_b, but the Israel evidence is a video title on her site framed around a 'Hydra Network' of London financiers [S6]. That is not a policy position on aid conditions or an arms embargo. Her platform also calls for fortified border security and a security-clearance overhaul [S4], which do not point toward reducing defense commitments.
